skill_name: Generate a story about a conflict between two siblings.
workflow: Once upon a time there were two siblings, Julie and John. John was always the overachiever and Julie, the younger sibling, often felt inadequate and jealous of her brother. When Julie got an invitation to a party and her brother did not, she felt as though she'd finally one up on him. However, John was determined to attend the party and resorted to sneaking out of the house at night.
